title: Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II
jp_title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World II
description: Once dismissed as the sole ordinary student at the elite Arnold Academy of Sorcery, Ray White—secretly, the Iceblade Sorcerer—has finally earned his place. With a new school year comes a new challenge: The Magicks War, a grand competition pitting teams from rival schools against each other. But an ominous shadow looms over Ray and his friends as the other grand sorcerers plot their next moves. (Source: Crunchyroll)
